sections.title: A room, one surface at a time
sections.content: Now put *-on/-en/-ön* to work describing a real room. You know *polc* ("shelf") and *bútor* ("furniture") from A1; new are *fal* ("wall"), *mennyezet* ("ceiling") and *padló* ("floor"). Like the shelf, they are all surfaces things rest on.

items.english: The shelf is on the wall.
The lamp is on the ceiling.
There are a lot of books on the shelf.

sections.content: Think of the wall, the ceiling and the floor as flat surfaces: things rest ON them, so they take *-on/-en/-ön* (*padlón* just adds *-n*).
